assertions.why: the skill file itself must exist
every description must stay <=200 chars or the skill picker truncates it
frontmatter name must equal the folder name
a model-invocable skill needs a Use-when trigger in its description
SKILL.md stays under 500 lines; detail lives in references/
tag, push and publish are hard gates the owner triggers with an explicit phrase
git-push is a text gate (match.kind regex); the PreToolUse hook only enforces command gates, so the skill must not claim a hook stops a push
the skill states plainly that the agent itself must keep the push gate
no release step runs for real before its dry run
actions are pinned to a commit SHA, never a movable tag
publishing uses OIDC trusted publishing instead of long-lived tokens
the skill must say how it behaves in a repo with no remote (local-only repos exist)
the conventional-commit to semver bump table is the core of the bump step

assertions.needle: Never move, delete or force-push a tag
assertions.why: a bad release is fixed forward, never by rewriting a pushed tag
no stored-secret reference or token example in the publish outline
provenance names the pinned SHA of the pattern source
